name: Sichuan 6912 Communication Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sichuan 6912 Communication Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of military training equipment and military-grade memory control chips in China. Its product portfolio includes military communications and command simulation training, as well as combat-oriented simulation training equipment. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Deyang, China.
